title: "What Does Hispanic Heritage Month Mean to You?" A Conversation with Dr. Paula Cuellar Cuellar
author: Emma Gonzalez
summary: In honor of Hispanic Heritage Month, Indigo Magazine sat down with Dr. Paula Cuellar Cuellar, a professor of Latin American history at UTD, to explore her story, cultural identity, and the significance of this month as both a celebration and a learning opportunity.

title: How To Ruin A First Date!
author: Manogna Bedhu
summary: Taken from real stories, here are 4 outrageous anecdotes of love mishaps, so you can get ever closer to cutting the right wire while keeping all parts of you and your partner intact.

title: "indiGO LIVE!" Introducing Belfast Duo: Chalk
author: Sanhita Perkari
summary: Emerging from a renowned film program in Belfast, Chalk has pushed new boundaries in the alt-rock world with their debut album, Crystalpunk. We caught up with Ben Goddard and Ross Cullen at FREQUENCY Fest in Dallas.

summary: UTD and Dignitas collaborate for a $1,000 Fornite Challenge. Why should we care?
